title: Simultaneous Dirichlet approximation for n real numbers via Minkowski

problemStatement.formal: \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, \forall \alpha : \mathrm{Fin}\,n \to \mathbb{R}, \forall Q \in \mathbb{N}^+, \exists q \in \mathbb{Z}, \exists p : \mathrm{Fin}\,n \to \mathbb{Z},\ 1 \le q \le Q^n \wedge \forall i, |q\,\alpha_i - p_i| < 1/Q
problemStatement.plain: Generalize MinkowskiTheoremOQ02.lean (1D Dirichlet approximation) to the n-dim simultaneous version: for any reals α₁,…,αₙ and any positive integer Q, there is a common integer denominator q with 1 ≤ q ≤ Qⁿ and integer numerators p₁,…,pₙ such that |qαᵢ - pᵢ| < 1/Q for all i.
whyMatters: n-dim Minkowski is already proved (MinkowskiFundamentalTheorem.lean:638, 0 axioms, 0 sorries) but is currently only used for the 2x2 fermat_from_minkowski toy example

Simultaneous Dirichlet approximation is the canonical application of n-dim geometry of numbers (Cassels 1957, Theorem I.II.A) and the gateway to metric Diophantine approximation (Khintchine, Schmidt subspace theorem)
No Mathlib library packages the simultaneous theorem at the theorem level; this OQ creates a reusable companion to the 1D parent

insights: MinkowskiProved.minkowski_integer_lattice_proved (MinkowskiFundamentalTheorem.lean:638) is already stated for arbitrary n; the n-dim Minkowski step is free.

All three measure-theoretic axioms in MinkowskiTheoremOQ02.lean have axiom-free analogs in MinkowskiTheoremOQ02OQ01.lean (IsOpen.measurableSet / Convex.linear_preimage / map_matrix_volume_pi_eq_smul_volume_pi) whose proof patterns lift to arbitrary n.

The Cassels 1957 shear map T v = (v 0, α 0 · v 0 - v 1, …, α (n-1) · v 0 - v n) is lower-triangular with diagonal (1, -1, …, -1), so M.det = (-1)ⁿ and |M.det| = 1 — the sign is irrelevant since volume uses |det|.

Indexing as Fin (n+1) with v 0 = common-denominator and v i.succ = i-th approximation matches both MinkowskiProved.minkowski_integer_lattice_proved's lattice signature and Mathlib's Fin.prod_univ_succ ergonomics; alternative Sum Unit (Fin n) encoding is rejected.
The conclusion bound q ≤ Qⁿ (vs. 1D's q ≤ Q) matches a parallelepiped of width 2(Qⁿ + 1) in coordinate 0, pushing volume past 2^(n+1) while keeping each approximation width at 2/Q.

S5-a ACT lessons (PR #18975, 2026-05-14): the corrected `BlockTriangular toDual` signature from S5 PREP-2 §2.4 fired `Matrix.det_of_lowerTriangular` directly without any further rewriting. The diagonal split `(shearM α) 0 0 = 1`, `(shearM α) k.succ k.succ = -1` was discharged via `Fin.prod_univ_succ` + `simp [shearM, Matrix.of_apply, Fin.succ_ne_zero]`, and the product `∏ k : Fin n, (-1) = (-1)^n` via `Finset.prod_const + Finset.card_univ + Fintype.card_fin`. Sorry-free, axiom-free in ~63 LOC. The same bearer-pre-staging discipline (S5 PREP-2 mathlib audit at pin 2df2f0...) should carry S5-b and S5-c through equally cleanly.

S5-b ACT lessons (PR #19046, 2026-05-15T23:27:39Z, build verified 3058 jobs): `Fin.cases` matching on dependent goals is opaque without explicit substitution; the row-`i.succ` case in `dirichletSetN_eq_shearM_preimage` discharges cleanly via `refine j.cases ?_ ?_` (Fin.cases on the variable directly) rather than `match`. The shear matrix's row decomposition for `(shearM.toLin' v) i.succ` uses `Matrix.toLin'_apply` to unfold the dot product, then `Finset.sum_eq_single` (one-non-trivial-summand collapse) to isolate the `α i * v 0 - v i.succ` form. Both bearers (`Matrix.toLin'_apply` at `Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/ToLin.lean:297`, `Finset.sum_eq_single` at `Mathlib/Algebra/BigOperators/Group/Finset/Basic.lean:1146`) fire as written at pin `2df2f0150c…`. S14 ACT lessons (researcher-1, 2026-05-31, this PR): the 'build pending — G9 lake self-loop' qualifier shipped on every recent OQ-02-OQ-03 ACT (#21239 / #21492 / #21529) was masking 8 real Lean compile errors plus 1 surface error (`lt_div_iff` → `lt_div_iff₀` rename at pin). Five generalised lessons for future ACTs: (1) ALWAYS Docker-verify before shipping a non-trivial Lean ACT — the cost is ~3 min wall-clock per iter and the qualifier-masked-bugs risk is high; (2) for ENNReal vs `(n : ℕ).cast` arithmetic, use `norm_num` to bridge `(2 : ENNReal) = ENNReal.ofReal 2` before `ENNReal.ofReal_pow`; (3) for `Finset.sum_ite_eq` vs `_eq'`: the prime version has the `Eq` args swapped (sum-var on the LHS instead of target), so match the goal's `i = x` direction; (4) for the `Subtype.ext + funext + i.cases` motif, `Pi.zero_apply` does NOT fire on the `Subtype` coercion's `0.val` — just drop the no-op simp and let `rw [hc 0, hc0]; simp` close; (5) for bearer-name verification at the project pin vs the local Mathlib clone HEAD, prefer `git show <pin>:<path>` (or check both unqualified and `₀`-decorated forms) — see [[reference_mathlib_source_paths_outside_g9_loop]] for the pin-divergence caveat documented in this session.
